description:
Finance Assistant

Location: Leicester, LE4
Hours: Part-time - approximately 20 hours per week (to be confirmed)
Working Arrangement: Fully office-based

The Role

Optima UK is recruiting on behalf of an established manufacturing business in Leicester that is looking for an experienced Finance Assistant to join its team on a part-time basis.

This is a varied, hands-on position covering credit control, purchase ledger, account reconciliations and payroll support. Credit control will be a key focus, making this an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of their workload and working as part of a supportive finance team.

- Credit Control: Manage approximately 60 customer accounts with a combined ledger value of around £1 million, chasing overdue payments, monitoring outstanding balances and maintaining positive customer relationships.

- Ability to manage workloads independently while contributing to a wider team.

company: Universal Flexible Packaging Ltd, Lunsford Road - Agency - Permanent
description:
Film Operations Executive Full Time

Location: Leicester

Company Info

Universal Flexible Packaging (UFP) supplies flexible packaging products to customers across a range of industries. We are looking for an organised, proactive Film Operations Executive to join our team and help deliver an excellent service to our customers.

You will work closely with colleagues across Operations, Sales, Marketing and Technical Compliance, with opportunities to develop your knowledge of flexible packaging and contribute ideas to improve how we work.

Reporting to the Film Operations Manager, you will help keep customer orders running smoothly, from initial processing through to delivery and invoicing. This varied role combines customer service, supplier coordination, logistics and stock control.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership of their work and likes seeing an order through from start to finish.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with:
- Experience in operations, order processing or customer service, ideally within packaging, manufacturing or another business-to-business environment.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail when processing orders, checking information and maintaining records.
- Clear, professional communication skills and a helpful, customer-focused approach.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office and the ability to learn order management, stock control and customer management systems.
- A practical approach to solving problems, with the judgement to escalate issues when needed.
- A reliable, proactive and collaborative working style.
- Flexibility to respond to changing priorities and a willingness to develop their knowledge.

Experience in stock management, logistics or warehouse coordination would be an advantage, as would an understanding of flexible packaging products.

Benefits
- Free Parking onsite
- A small team where you can make a real difference
- Smart Casual dress
